home.title: Retrofit underfloor heating without breaking up the floor
home.lead: We mill channels in your existing screed and lay the heating pipes in the floor you already have. 50 m² takes one day, and the dust goes straight into an industrial vacuum.
home.description: Underfloor heating milled into the screed you already have. 50 m² in one day, no dust. Rated 5.0 on Google, 70+ reviews. All of Poland.
home.heading: A warm floor without breaking up the old one.
home.aboutTitle: Underfloor heating milling is all we do.
home.aboutBody: We are based in Lesser Poland and for 6 years we have been travelling to clients all over the country. We fit underfloor heating in old houses, in apartment blocks and on new builds. We mill with an industrial vacuum attached, so you can carry on living at home while we work.
home.busAlt: Kubik's blue van with the lettering “Milled underfloor heating”
home.serviceTitle: One day between you and a warm floor.

cookies.title: This site uses cookies
cookies.message: We use cookies so the site works properly and so we know what could be improved. Details are in our
cookies.dialogDescription: Choose which categories you want to enable. You can change your choice at any time.

necessary.label: Necessary
necessary.description: They keep your session, protect forms and remember this very cookie decision. The site doesn't work without them, so they can't be switched off.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: They show us which pages get visited and where people get lost. The data is aggregated — it isn't used to identify individuals.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.description: They let us measure how well ads work and show ads to people who have visited the site. They are behind the “following” ads on other websites.

preferences.label: Preferences
preferences.description: They remember choices such as language or light/dark theme, so you don't have to set them on every visit.

cookies.decisionRequired: To use the site, choose “Accept” or open “Settings”.
cookies.lockedSwitch: This category is required and can't be switched off.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Plain language wherever possible. What data we collect, why, and how you can get it back from us.

administrator.title: Who processes your data
administrator.body: The data controller is the company that comes to you with the milling machine. If you have a question about your data, you write to or call us — not a legal department.

data.title: What data we collect
data.body: Only what you enter in the quote form, and what is collected by the cookies you agree to.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.purpose: To call you back with a quote.

area.label: Floor area and town
area.purpose: To work out the price and plan the journey.

technical.label: Technical data
technical.purpose: IP address, browser, pages visited — only if you consent to analytics cookies.

purposes.title: Why, and on what legal basis
purposes.body: Preparing a quote and booking a date are steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). We keep invoices and accounts because tax law requires it (point c). Site statistics and advertising run only with your consent (point a), which you can withdraw at any time.

retention.title: How long
retention.body: Enquiries that don't lead to a job are deleted after 12 months. Accounting documents are kept for 5 years from the end of the tax year. Cookie data is kept until you withdraw consent, and no longer than 13 months.

recipients.title: Who we share it with
recipients.body: We don't sell data. Access is limited to companies that help us run the website and the office: hosting (Vercel), email (Google), our accounting firm and — with your consent — analytics and advertising providers (Google, Meta).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We divide them into four categories. Necessary cookies always work; the others only once you switch them on. You can change your decision at any time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask to access, correct, delete, restrict or transfer your data, and you can object to its processing. Just email {email} — we reply within 30 days. If you believe we are breaking the law, you can lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw).

service.title: Floor milling for underfloor heating: price and process
service.description: Screed milling for retrofit underfloor heating, without breaking up the floor. See what the price per m² depends on and get a free quote.
service.heading: Floor milling for underfloor heating.
service.lead: Already have a screed and want underfloor heating? No need to break it up. Underfloor heating in your existing screed: we mill channels into it, lay the pipes and fill them in, and the floor doesn't rise by even a centimetre.
service.howTitle: Instead of breaking up the floor, we cut channels for the pipes.
service.howBody: We mill the screed with a machine connected to an industrial vacuum. The milling machine cuts channels as deep as the pipe, and the dust goes straight into the bag. That's why reviews mostly mention one thing: zero dust.
service.howBadge: Milling machine with an industrial vacuum
service.howPhotoAlt: Milling machine connected to an industrial vacuum in a walk-in wardrobe during milling
service.fitTitle: Will it work in my home? Usually, yes.
service.fitNote: Not sure what screed you have? Text a photo to {phone} and we'll assess it for free.
